yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yields.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

younger.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.

zigzag.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zigzags.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zirconium.definition: A chemical element (symbol Zr) with an atomic number of 40, a strong, lustrous, grey-white transition metal mainly used as a refractory and opacifier.

zone.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).

zoophytes.definition: An animal thought to have the characteristics of a plant, later specifically an invertebrate of the (former) group Zoophyta, comprising sponges, corals and sea anemones.
